question: What topics will be treated in the twentieth chapter?
premises: The twentieth chapter deals with consecration ending in the examination of qualification.
The twentieth chapter also deals with the rite of the balance.
These topics constitute the entire subject matter to be stated there.
inference: Therefore, the twentieth chapter will present consecration culminating in qualification-examination and the rite of the balance.
uncertainties: The exact ritual sense of tulāvidhi may depend on later exposition in the twentieth chapter.
plain_english: In the twentieth chapter, the full subject to be explained will be consecration ending with the examination of qualification, and also the rite of the balance.
